- 为什么改:PR #26970 把 `concepts/north-star.mdx` 改名,这两处按文件路径/站内路由写的链接会让 Check Documentation Links 变红;改成线上 URL 后,改名前后都是绿的,无需与 #26970 排先后。
- 风险与回滚:极低,纯文档两行,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`(跨行链接只改了括号内目标)、`CHANGELOG.md` 第 1033 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n 'concepts/north-star' -- CHANGELOG.md content/docs/releases/`,预期只出现两行,且都是 `https://objectstack.ai/docs/concepts/north-star` 形式。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Two link targets on release-owned surfaces, and nothing else:

- `CHANGELOG.md` L1033: `[north-star §8](content/docs/concepts/north-star.mdx)` becomes `[north-star §8](https://objectstack.ai/docs/concepts/north-star)`.
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx` L1482-1483: the link that wraps across two lines keeps its text and line break; only its target `(/docs/concepts/north-star)` becomes `(https://objectstack.ai/docs/concepts/north-star)`.

Diff: 2 files, +2 / -2. This is the dedicated docs-only PR the release-owned correction channel requires, kept out of #26970 for that reason. No changeset: nothing in any package's `files[]` moves (`skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes

- Why the https form is green on both sides of the rename was verified on `origin/main` (`7bb8084590`), not assumed. `.github/workflows/check-links.yml` sets `LYCHEE_ARGS` to start with `--offline`. Its comment there reads "Offline means only `file://` targets are resolved -- every http(s) link is reported EXCLUDED, never requested." No line in `lychee.toml` does the exclusion: its `exclude` list names no `objectstack.ai` entry and is documented as inert under `--offline`. The flag is the mechanism. These links are therefore never fetched in CI, and the URL is also reachable today because the page exists until #26970 lands.
- lychee is not installed in this container, so it was NOT MEASURED locally. This PR's `Check Documentation Links` run is the reading.
